instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard .js and React components with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn primitives.
Implement real Gemini API responses on backend/frontend with typing streaming simulation if needed.
Store chat history and custom characters in local storage or backend DB (FastAPI + SQLite/In-Memory).
Ensure total responsive fidelity: Mobile users get bottom tab navigation, desktop users get side/top navigation.
Enforce rate limit counter UI (50 daily messages, 6 per minute) with visible feedback and error toasts/banners.
Ensure pt-BR strings for all user-facing content.
Always attach data-testid attributes to all key interactive elements.
